subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should PR 89238, or a refreshed successor, be the canonical path for ordinary same-session visible messages to reach active-run queue policy?
rationale: Current main solved the slash-command and active non-streaming subset, but the remaining ordinary-message admission layer affects ordering, fallback, terminal-session recovery, and channel delivery semantics that should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Refresh the candidate PR
options.body: Use PR 89238 or a replacement to preserve PR 98126 and PR 89045 behavior while making accepted queue-policy turns explicit enough to avoid invisible fallback.

options.title: Narrow to explicit command steering
options.body: Close the ordinary visible-message part as out of scope and document that only explicit steering commands bypass channel serialization.

options.title: Defer to scheduler work
options.body: Keep this issue linked but block implementation on the broader concurrency design in issue 56880.

recommendation.title: Refresh the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Use PR 89238 or a replacement to preserve PR 98126 and PR 89045 behavior while making accepted queue-policy turns explicit enough to avoid invisible fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged partial fix and documented the remaining unresolved ordinary-message boundary in the issue discussion.
